E01.text: On the first pass each step compares the value carried so far with the next element of the input, keeping the smaller on the left and the larger on the right.
E01.quote:
Each step $j$ carries the already-settled left region forward, compares the
  running value at position $j$ against the next array element $A_{j+1}$, and
  writes $\min$ to position $j$ and $\max$ to position $j+1$.

E02.text: A later pass starts from the row the previous pass ended with, sorting its first two positions and copying the rest.
E02.quote:
Each later pass $i$ instead reads pass $i-1$'s
  final row

E03.text: On later passes the element coming in at each step is the next cell of the previous pass's final row.
E03.quote:
The incoming element $R$ is $A_{j+1}$ on pass $0$ (still bubbling through the raw
  input) and $Z_{i-1,\,J-1,\,j+1}$ on later passes

init.text: The sort starts by putting the first two input values in order.
init.quote:
Pass $0$ reads the raw input:
  $\min(A_0, A_1)$ lands at position $0$ and $\max(A_0, A_1)$ at position $1$;

stop.text: The passes end when a whole sweep leaves the array unchanged, which means it is sorted.
stop.quote:
The pass cascade
  halts when a whole sweep produces no change, i.e. the array is sorted.

tensorNotes.Z: the value at each position after each step of each pass
